denominator_contract: Every id in required_case_ids must exist in testdata/ddl-golden/T09.json or in a named unit/e2e test. Removing a case, loosening an expectation, or shrinking the denominator without amending this file is a contract violation. Role ids freeze to golden-runner namespaces T09.cli/T09.clierr/T09.meta plus the corpus rows that un-defer ddl.alter.add_index.redundant_unique_overlap.forbid.

fixtures.golden.t9: a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i INT (nine columns, index set created-empty inside the fixture)
fixtures.golden.t9i: a,b,c,d INT; KEY i_ab(a,b); UNIQUE KEY uq_cd(c,d); KEY i_abc(a,b,c)
fixtures.golden.t9p: a INT NOT NULL, b INT; PRIMARY KEY(a)
fixtures.golden.t9o: a,b INT (other-table role for cross-table same-name control)

policies.t09-naming: ddl.index.secondary.prefix.require idx_ + ddl.alter.add_index.secondary.prefix.require idx_ + ddl.index.unique.prefix.require uq_ + ddl.alter.add_index.unique.prefix.require uq_ + ddl.constraint.unique_key.name.prefix.require uc_ @blocker
policies.t09-naming-custom: same families with custom prefixes ix_/uk_/cu_
policies.t09-exists: ddl.alter.add_index.exists.forbid + ddl.alter.drop_index.exists.require + ddl.alter.rename_index.exists.require + ddl.alter.drop_primary_key.exists.require + ddl.create_index.columns.exists.require + ddl.table.exists.alter.require @blocker
